verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Capacities search works offline on all devices with quick results and tolerates inexact wording, which covers the instant, offline search part of the story. The pack never documents full-text indexing of note bodies or search filters by tag, property or path; 'Smart queries' appears only as a pricing-page bullet with no detail. Missing for 10: documented full-text search of note content, tag/property/path filters within search, independent or hands-on corroboration of offline search speed.
